verdict.rationale: Insomnia's first-party docs describe pre-request and after-response scripting that adds logic to requests. Pre-request scripts can change environment variables, auth and request contents. Request chaining extracts values from other responses and shares state across requests. Missing for 10: detail on what after-response scripts can do (e.g. parsing or transforming response data), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scripting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can script pre-request and post-response logic to chain requests and massage data

citations.quote: Pre-request and after-response scripting to add logic to your requests
Manipulate environment variables or authentication * Manipulate the contents of the request
you can extract values from the responses of other requests while also sharing state across requests
Test complex workflows by chaining the responses from requests together
